_meta.description: Limits and correction text for .claude/hooks/ask-question-shape-hook.js (#3233). Claude Code renders AskUserQuestion question text in bold, so context belongs in markdown printed before the call, not in the question. maxOptions and maxHeaderLength are the tool's own hard limits (#3198); maxQuestionLength is a convention threshold: one sentence.

remedy.singleSelect: Print the context as ordinary markdown before the call, keep `question` to one sentence, and put long per-option content in that option's `preview`.
remedy.multiSelect: Print the context as ordinary markdown before the call, keep `question` to one sentence, and keep short option descriptions. Previews render only for single-select questions, so none are suggested here.

convention: When a table of candidates or findings is printed before the prompt, its first column is `{n}.{label}`, with no space after the dot: `{n}` is the number Claude Code shows beside the option, `{label}` the option's label (row `1.Threshold boundary` matches option `Threshold boundary`).
Option labels carry no number prefix: Claude Code numbers options in single- and multi-select prompts alike, so a prefixed label renders as `1. 1.Label`.
A single item's context (one finding, one record) is a bold-label list (`**Criterion:**`, `**Detail:**`), not a table. Tables are for rows that map to options.
A preview showing a change uses BEFORE / AFTER blocks, never diff `-`/`+` markers, which collide with `- [ ]` checkboxes.
A call carrying several questions prints one option table per question, under a bold heading matching that question's `header`, numbering from 1 each time.
